observationRules.necessaryEvidence: Record input/AC/scenario, producer and independent observer, exact source snapshot, commands/cwd, expected and observed behavior, relevant assertions, result/exit status, artifact references and remaining limitations.
observationRules.negativeControls: A test-first red or injected diagnostic scenario must fail for the intended behavioral reason, not missing files/dependencies, syntax or broken harness. Label synthetic/evolution scenarios explicitly.
observationRules.conditionalCoverage: N/A needs an applicability reason and is not PASS. Do not force speculative migration or prototype into production solely to inflate coverage. If user expects every conditional branch exercised, separately scope authorized scenarios before implementation.
observationRules.causalLimit: One app run can demonstrate observed workflow adherence and app correctness; it cannot establish prompt-induced improvements, statistical reliability or all future branches.

features.name: Fresh-context, read-only research and permission discipline
features.trigger: Every non-trivial requirement; diagnosis does not widen researcher permissions.
features.observe: A fresh researcher receives complete requirement/scope and writes only authorized artifacts; no implementation, installs or nested delegation. Parent owns ACs and Gate 1.
features.proof: Delegation contract, tool transcript, source status/diff, accessible artifact.
features.conditional: Unavailable research delegation is a blocker, not inline fallback. Trivial tier skips full report.

features.name: Requirement coverage, behavior trace and reuse
features.trigger: Research for each assigned AC/sub-deliverable.
features.observe: Opened definitions and real callers/contracts, validation, state, errors, side effects, configuration, consumers, representative helpers and actual assertions support every coverage row.
features.proof: Trace from entry point through real seams; cited source snippets and current tests, not file names alone.
features.conditional: An absent reusable helper must have bounded search evidence; do not invent a helper or architecture.

features.name: Typed evidence, scoped absence and source freshness
features.trigger: Every material research claim and subsequent changed snapshot.
features.observe: FACT/INFERENCE/HYPOTHESIS/UNKNOWN labels, source anchors, commands/run status, scoped absence searches, SHA and dirty paths; refresh invalidated facts after edits.
features.proof: Resolve sampled citations and a cross-component/not-found claim against exact tree; verify no unknown silently promoted.

features.name: Standalone downstream handoff and acceptance
features.trigger: Research completion, fresh design consumer and later app milestone/resume.
features.observe: Fresh consumer can use complete report and linked requirement records; parent samples three citations, reconciles all ACs and resolves design-changing unknowns.
features.proof: Recorded consumer input locations, acceptance findings/dispositions and source revalidation; no hidden chat knowledge.

features.name: Planning lineage and phase ownership
features.trigger: Non-trivial Phase 3.
features.observe: Planner consumes accepted research, approved or explicitly unconfirmed headless design, ACs and decisions at named versions; planning changes no implementation and invents no new architecture.
features.proof: Fresh-context planning contract, linked snapshots and revision, accessible output.
features.conditional: If planning delegation unavailable only, inline fallback is recorded; missing facts return to research, design changes return to design.

features.name: Vertical increments, dependency graph and ownership
features.trigger: All planned app changes.
features.observe: One owning task per change; prerequisites precede users; no cycles/shared-file concurrency; increments deliver demonstrable behavior rather than horizontal unfinished layers.
features.proof: Graph and exact file/task map; green reviewed commits at slice boundaries; integrated whole-app outcome.
features.conditional: Parallel work only for independent disjoint responsibilities; same component can recur sequentially with distinct owned changes.

features.name: Executable task and check contracts
features.trigger: Every implementation task/check.
features.observe: Stable IDs, AC/design references, entry conditions, exact changes, reuse, preserved/excluded behavior, expected proof, owner/timing, failure recovery, status and evidence.
features.proof: Fresh implementer locates first task and failure/dependency boundary using artifacts alone. Commands specify shell/cwd/prerequisites and relevant assertions, not just exit zero.

features.name: Compact authoritative artifacts and consumer readiness
features.trigger: Gate 3 and incoming implementer.
features.observe: HTML overview <=3 printed pages with dependency diagram; detailed tasks linked when needed, not duplicated. Parent records READY/REVISE/BLOCKED and reconciles all ACs/changes, not sample only.
features.proof: Measured rendering/page output when available, resolved links, parent readiness record and implementer prerequisite confirmation.
features.conditional: Extra planning review only for genuinely high-risk/complex dependencies, not a mandatory new reviewer.

features.name: Evidence-backed progress and independent gates
features.trigger: Per-increment completion and final reconciliation.
features.observe: Planned checks remain not run; partial spanning ACs not VERIFIED; future work does not fail earlier slice; Phase 5 verifier differs from implementer and Phase 6 reviewer re-derives results.
features.proof: Task/check evidence linked to commits and independent observed results; final whole-request AC matrix.
features.conditional: Human-owned acceptance cannot be confirmed by agent/screenshot. Production-release items need evidence before relevant release, or N/A reasons.

features.name: Controlled plan revision and source-aware resume
features.trigger: Feedback, changed source/prerequisite, oversized increment or resumed session.
features.observe: Record mismatch/impact, stop dependents, route new facts/design changes, preserve stable IDs, update tasks/checks/recovery/state/traceability together and invalidate stale completion evidence.
features.proof: Before/after plan revision and source evidence; affected Gate 2/3 recheck; fresh consumer follows revised first ready task.
features.conditional: No actual mismatch/resume means NOT_EXERCISED for that branch, not proof from a templated revision log.

features.name: Message shape at meaningful transitions
features.trigger: Progress/resume, approval, blocker/partial success, completion.
features.observe: Lead with concrete current outcome/blocker/decision, then relevant next action or artifact; messages agree with current evidence and omit invented percentages/estimates.
features.proof: Actual transcript at gates and a real blocker, compared with command outputs and state.

features.name: Concise presentation without hiding truth
features.trigger: Long evidence, multiple blockers or explicit detailed-answer request.
features.observe: Full handoffs/checks remain complete; material failures, risks and uncertainty visible; no arbitrary item cap or medical assumptions.
features.proof: Transcript-to-artifact coverage audit; detailed requested output and all material limitations retained.

features.name: Uncertainty, action ownership and clean stopping
features.trigger: Failure without known cause, safe next step, real human decision or finished work.
features.observe: Separate observed failure from verified cause/hypothesis; perform agent-owned safe work; preserve true human approval boundary; finish without artificial follow-up.
features.proof: Real failed command and subsequent diagnosis/actions, or explicitly unconfirmed unattended sign-off; final incomplete/complete wording matches results.

features.name: Readable responsibility boundaries and owned contracts/state
features.trigger: App design, production source and final review.
features.observe: Trace normal path, decisions, I/O and failure flow; helpers own coherent responsibility; shared boundary contracts defined once; validation/state/cleanup ownership clear.
features.proof: Independent source-reading review and tests of state transitions/error distinctions; no reliance solely on author's design narrative.

features.name: Behavior-preserving clarity and simple sufficient abstractions
features.trigger: Implementation or structural refactor.
features.observe: Domain/action names, straightforward branches, explicit failures and suitable reuse; no speculative framework or maze of wrappers; cleanup/ordering/error contracts preserved.
features.proof: Concrete source locations plus regression assertions; lower line count/complexity alone is not acceptance.

features.name: Comment and behavior-bearing text discipline
features.trigger: Comments and changed runtime prompts/tool descriptions/schemas.
features.observe: Keep non-obvious why/invariants/API contracts and notices; update stale comments; no incident history/timestamps/local evidence paths in production comments; classify runtime text before shortening.
features.proof: Final diff/source review with contract tests for behavior-bearing text when actually changed.
features.conditional: Runtime prompt/schema modification may be N/A for the app; absence of such changes is not an exercised preservation test.

features.name: Concrete readability review without metric gaming
features.trigger: Existing review/disposition process.
features.observe: Findings cite location, behavior/maintenance cost and proportionate remedy; reject only substantive in-scope issues; no arbitrary size/comment quota, separate readability report or unrelated cleanup.
features.proof: Independent review and dispositions, final source and unchanged-or-stronger assertions. Metrics supplement rather than substitute for judgment.

features.name: Symptom-specific diagnosis reproduction
features.trigger: Reported app defect or explicitly labeled authorized diagnostic scenario.
features.observe: Real public-path failure with original input, expected/observed outcome, command/cwd/snapshot; insensitive did-not-crash/setup error is not reproduction.
features.proof: Original failing transcript and preserved replay case before fix proposal.
features.conditional: No defect observed means NOT_EXERCISED unless separate scenario authorized. Needed harness writes belong to parent/write-scoped worker.

features.name: Minimize and distinguish causes with evidence
features.trigger: Reproduced defect; causal ambiguity where present.
features.observe: Reduce one factor at a time without losing causal path; rank plausible causes when ambiguous, predict discriminating observations and update hypotheses from probes.
features.proof: Original/minimized inputs and outcomes; relevant source trace plus targeted experiment; supported cause clearly separated from hypothesis.
features.conditional: Obvious source-and-observation-backed cause needs no artificial hypothesis count. Unresolved cause remains blocker, not speculative patch.

features.name: Diagnosis through normal gates and original-case regression proof
features.trigger: Fixing established defect.
features.observe: Design correction, planned red regression test, fix, minimized and original reruns and affected regressions; independent verifier replays original case; owned instrumentation removed.
features.proof: Red/green logs, final regression test, both case outcomes, cleanup-marker check and reviewer evidence.
features.conditional: Performance/intermittent cases require comparable workload/environment/baseline and bounded samples; one green run does not prove absence.

features.name: Small test-first red/green/refactor cycles
features.trigger: Each new/changed behavior.
features.observe: One focused behavior check fails for expected reason before change; smallest complete implementation passes; refactor stays green; repeat without speculative all-tests-first plan.
features.proof: Chronological test/source snapshots and commands showing relevant red and green; unavailable pre-change proof explicitly recorded.
features.conditional: Missing dependency, nonexistent import or syntax failure is not expected behavioral red and cannot count as PASS.

features.name: Stable behavioral tests and real side-effect boundaries
features.trigger: Choosing test interfaces or refactoring app modules.
features.observe: Requirements/worked examples independently determine expected results; tests use stable public seams; persisted/event side effects verified where contracted; collaborators not all mocked.
features.proof: Unit, integration and live surface assertions, failure/boundary cases; deleted tests mapped to equivalent or stronger remaining scenarios.

features.name: Decision prerequisites before execution-ready tasks
features.trigger: Uncertain/large work with unresolved factual or design decisions.
features.observe: Separate decision questions from ready tasks, name owners/blocking prerequisites/AC impact and resolution evidence; research inspectable facts without unnecessary human questions.
features.proof: Current clarification/design record linked from task readiness; unresolved downstream questions marked not-yet-specified, not complete or out of scope.
features.conditional: Do not invent interviews/new approvals/trackers. Headless requirement assumptions do not prove unknown APIs.

features.name: Expand–migrate–contract compatibility changes
features.trigger: Wide rename/schema/shared-contract migration that cannot safely land by ordinary feature slice.
features.observe: Compatible form first, bounded ordered consumer migration, old form removed only after scoped caller searches and regression/compatibility proof; all deliverable increments green.
features.proof: Before/after consumers and persisted contracts, batch targets, compatibility tests, retirement search and recovery limits.
features.conditional: Greenfield app without existing consumers/data is N/A. Deployment requires old/new coexistence and rollback window evidence; destructive execution needs separate authorization.

features.name: Domain vocabulary and caller-burden interface review
features.trigger: Material domain ambiguity or changed public interface.
features.observe: Resolve terms/states against real code and scenarios; realistic caller example exposes invariants, ordering, error/config/performance burden; abstraction hides useful responsibility.
features.proof: Existing design decision table with source-backed terms and caller example; no glossary/ADR created solely for ceremony.

features.name: Consequential alternatives and proportionate decision records
features.trigger: Consequential interface decision or costly-to-reverse surprising trade-off.
features.observe: Compare materially different alternatives, caller burden and where future change concentrates; recommendation justified in current design.
features.proof: Alternatives table and approved/unconfirmed decision provenance; durable ADR only if appropriate and in scope.
features.conditional: Routine interface choices do not require artificial alternative exercise or agent fan-out.

features.name: Question-driven isolated prototypes
features.trigger: A design question truly needs experimental resolution.
features.observe: Question, success signal, bounded scope and stop condition agreed before experiment; isolate from production wiring/data; capture conclusion/limits then remove or clearly retain nonrelease artifact.
features.proof: Experiment contract, measured observation and cleanup/exclusion, resulting design disposition.
features.conditional: No design uncertainty needing experiment means N/A. Prototype success is not production proof or design sign-off.

features.name: Categorized, snapshot-complete review
features.trigger: Self and independent review.
features.observe: Pin review base/head and relevant dirty/untracked files; classify SPEC, STANDARD and DESIGN CONCERN with AC/rule/source basis and cost; keep requirement and quality verdicts separate.
features.proof: Full final diff/status, deduplicated findings/dispositions, per-AC observed verdict and final tree reconciliation.
features.conditional: Do not add reviewers solely for categories or relabel preferences as binding rules; missing spec remains verification gap.

features.name: Progressive disclosure and workflow-changing text verification
features.trigger: Editing the workflow itself rather than only using it.
features.observe: Behavior lives in canonical SKILL/references with phase/branch load triggers; avoid duplicated rules, preserve complete handoffs and exact task commands; validate affected branches, not phrase presence/word count.
features.proof: If parent changes workflow prompts, inspect changed triggers and run the relevant live branch.
features.conditional: App-only exercise observes loading current procedures but does not itself exercise editing/maintaining the skill. Keep this branch N/A or separately scoped.

compatibleSeams.recommendation: Use established Node ESM/native node:test and strict assertions for compatible app verification rather than introducing a parallel framework. Native TS requires supported syntax and explicit imports; type stripping is not type checking.

Real pure-rule-to-HTTP adapter and shared response helper are representative seam/test patterns. Do not import unrelated discount business logic or inherit unchecked request buffering/static serving behavior blindly.

Existing UI fixture demonstrates a static module/browser seam. Parent must reconcile designated agent-browser with existing Playwright fixtures; merely substituting browser drivers without disclosure would not verify the designated-tool workflow.

If extending the corpus is approved, the task JSON/held-out oracle seam avoids runner changes. Its single-file quality/mutation and shallow test discovery are limited for a multi-module app; preserve genuine app checks rather than forcing all app code into one file to score well.
